description: This file defines the UserDao interface, which extends a generic DAO for user entity operations, including methods for retrieving users by username, listing users, and listing users by merchant store.

classes.name: UserDao
classes.description: Interface extending generic DAO for User entity operations, providing methods to fetch users based on different criteria.

methods.name: getByUserName
methods.description: Fetches a User entity based on the provided username.

methods.name: listUser
methods.description: Returns a list of all User entities.

methods.name: listUserByStore
methods.description: Returns a list of User entities associated with a specific merchant store.
